# Broadcast

<!-- Generated by tools/theme-readme-gen.py from scheme.toml; do not edit. -->

Terminal-inspired colors for GNOME (GTK 3, GTK 4 and libadwaita, GNOME Shell) and for terminals and command-line tools. Variants: dark only.

![Broadcast dark palette](palette-dark.svg)

- Colors: Broadcast (colours of the Ptyxis built-in 'Broadcast'; origin named in the built-in's header: https://github.com/Gogh-Co/Gogh/tree/master/themes/Broadcast.yml).
- Default accent: yellow (#FFD24A); the other accents are listed by `switch-theme`.
- Ptyxis uses its built-in palette `Broadcast`.

## Install and use

```
ujust gnome-candy install-theme broadcast
ujust gnome-candy switch-theme broadcast
```

Without the image recipe, run `just install-theme broadcast` and `just switch-theme broadcast` in a checkout of [candy-for-gnome](https://github.com/redcodeworks/candy-for-gnome).
